question: For each fundraising platform that sends DAFpay's `anonymous` flag (Givebutter, Bloomerang, Donorbox, Funraise, Fundraise Up, GiveCampus, BetterWorld), read its public help pages to establish (a) how the donor sets anonymity on the form, (b) whether the platform's own donor record keeps name and email for an anonymous DAFpay gift, and (c) whether the Chariot export for that gift is blank or populated. Public docs only; no sandbox keys
conclusion_affected: DAFpay anonymity critique; whether anonymity is enforced anywhere in the nonprofit-side stack
rationale: Chariot's integration guide says the platform passes `anonymous` so the gift 'can be properly anonymized by the DAF provider', in the same callback that passes the donor's name and email. Chariot's Grant object has no anonymity field, and Fundraise Up records 'the supporter who recommended the grant' as the donor by default. The nonprofit-side record therefore seems to hold identity whatever the flag says, but no platform page states it

question: Check whether any U.S. probability sample measures DAF holding after 2021: the PSID Philanthropy Panel Study Section M (2021, 2023, 2025 waves) and HRS 2022/2024 questionnaires, through copies at ICPSR/openICPSR or other hosts whose robots.txt can be read (psidonline and hrs.isr.umich.edu returned 403 to robots.txt). Also check the 2025 SCF questionnaire when the Federal Reserve publishes its codebook
conclusion_affected: Independent benchmark for DAF penetration by wealth percentile
rationale: The 2022 SCF codebook has no DAF item. Its only DAF mention excludes DAFs from the trust question, and the public file merges that code with 'trusts'. PSID and HRS could not be read under the robots rule, so the absence there is unverified. Every penetration figure in the repo comes from sponsor- or bank-run convenience surveys

question: From The American College's own published bios only, record the current employer of each of the 22 listed DAFCP instructors and the DAF Forum 2027 speakers. Classify each as DAF sponsor, processor or recordkeeper, independent consultant, academic, or other, and report the share tied to DAF sponsors. Combine this with the DAF Forum Premier Partner list to score the credential's sponsor exposure
conclusion_affected: Industry incentives; independence of adviser education
rationale: The DAF Forum's four Premier Partners are the four largest national sponsors, and one DAFCP instructor is an NPT executive (from NPT's own page). The other instructors' affiliations are not on the DAFCP page. Without them the sponsor share of the new credential's faculty cannot be stated
